subject: Post-signature governance & rollout ops map — AsterPoint Health
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@asterpointhealth.com>; Tom Blake <tom.blake@astor-consulting.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature governance & rollout ops map — AsterPoint Health

Hi Lena & Tom,

Thanks again for signing — welcome aboard. Attached is an initial ops map that embeds our post-signature cadence: staged rollout, canary windows, migration cutover, and training milestones. This is intentionally prescriptive so the cross-functional teams can align before we start environment provisioning next week.

High-level timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (Aug 11–14): Environment provisioning + config freeze (Redwood infra + AsterPoint sandbox)
- Week 1 (Aug 17–21): Integration testing + baseline eval (small sample set)
- Week 2 (Aug 24–28): Canary 1 (internal traffic only) — 5% production equivalent
- Week 3 (Aug 31–Sep 04): Canary 2 (pilot customers) — 25% traffic; training sessions
- Week 4 (Sep 07–11): Full cutover window reserved; rollback plan in place

Evaluation & acceptance criteria (summary):
- Latency P95 < 1200ms for typical 512-token flows
- Error rate (5xx/4xx) < 0.2% sustained
- Semantic quality: BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxy pass on evaluation prompts (attached)
- Cost delta vs. baseline not to exceed +15% without explicit approval

Action items for this thread (can you confirm owners/dates?):
1) AsterPoint: confirm sandbox dataset availability (Lena) — target Aug 13
2) Redwood: share runtime config and canary checklist (Priyom) — target Aug 12 (attached)
3) CS/Training: schedule two 60-min training sessions for pilot users (Marissa) — target Aug 20

Attachments: AsterPoint_MAP_v1.pdf, evaluation_prompts_and_metrics.xlsx, canary_checklist.md

Also linking the signed DocuSign envelope for records: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/12345abcdef

If that timeline looks good I’ll lock the provisioning window and book the canary readiness call for Aug 16.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the thorough map. Quick answers:
- Sandbox dataset: we can make a reduced de-identified extract available by Aug 14 (security has to sign off).
- Training: pilot cohort of 6 clinicians is available Aug 25 and Aug 27 afternoons — prefer the latter but we can do both if you want two sessions.

A couple of asks from our side before we lock provisioning:
1) Can you confirm data retention controls for the sandbox and whether KV cache is disabled for that environment? We need auditability for the eval window.
2) For canary metrics, can you include per-model token cost estimates so our finance reviewer (cc’d Tom) can sign off?

I’ll coordinate internal security and get back by EOD Aug 13.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director, Data & Clinical Ops — AsterPoint Health

Hi Lena, Priya,

Thanks — quick clarification and a couple of commitments from the Redwood side.

Sandbox controls: by default KV cache is disabled for sandbox tiers; we’ll also enable a 7-day retention policy and streaming audit logs scoped to the sandbox project. I’ll share the retention policy doc and audit extract example to the Drive folder today.

Cost estimates: attached spreadsheet includes per-model token cost and a projected cost table for the two canary waves (5% and 25%) based on the traffic profile you shared. Headline: Canary 1 (5%) projected incremental cost is ~ $1,200/week; Canary 2 (25%) projected incremental cost is ~ $6,400/week (ballpark until we tune batching).

Canary acceptance checklist (summary, full checklist attached):
- Pre-checks: smoke tests pass in infra (+ infra-health >= 99.9%), integration tests green, dataset QC complete
- Health gates during canary: rolling latency P95, token-cost per minute, 4xx/5xx thresholds, quality regression alerts tied to eval prompts
- Rollback triggers: sustained P95 > 2x baseline for 15+ minutes OR error rate > 1% OR quality regressions on > 2 eval prompts

Proposed schedule update:
- Provisioning: Aug 17 (we’ll move provisioning one week to give security time for sandbox sign-off)
- Canary 1 (internal QA): Aug 24–26
- Canary 2 (pilot customers): Sep 01–03
- Cutover window: Sep 09–10

Marissa — can you confirm training slots and provide a short pilot-user playbook? I’ve put the canary checklist in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3MAP-AsterPoint

Lena — once you confirm sandbox availability Aug 14 I’ll spin up the sandbox and share access.

Thanks,
Priyom
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
